status: One planned follow-up after primary study, not a replacement of primary scores
hypothesis: Covering the blocked response region improves PINN screening and errors under the same training budget
no_tuning: Architecture, objective, scaling, optimizer, steps and seeds unchanged; no stopping or further sweep based on fresh scores
design_rule: Replace16evenlyindexed sorted training nodes with16equallyspaced interior block nodes
scope: Both arms256traininggeometries, pairedstates; originalsavedmodelsreused; three newPINNfits only

original.status: Follow-up paired coverage control, fresh geometry-only evaluation frozen before fitting
original.hyperparameter_selection: None; fixed budget. Validation diagnostic only.
original.physics_loss: mean complex squared PDE V + PDE I + driven interface /4 + short
original.data_loss: mean |V-Vref|^2+|I-Iref|^2, same geometry/xi stream and architecture
original.reference_cost: Reference fields generated on demand in both runs for shared diagnostic logging; included in training wall time and timed separately, never added twice
original.no_test_training: No reference labels or residual points from test/validation geometries; blocked d excluded from training
original.analytic_factor: R_s(a,d)=exp(-2 gamma a)*r_s(d); phase separation depends only on d
